name: Brigitte van den Berg - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on boosting skills in the Union – opportunities for vocational education and training in times of transition
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It sets out its opinion on vocational education and training – practical, work-based learning such as apprenticeships. It asks for these pathways to be valued as highly as university study, for more money and support for learners, teachers and small businesses, and for qualifications to be recognised more easily across borders. It also calls for more women in technical fields and better access for people with disabilities or fewer opportunities.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states its position and asks the European Commission to act.
- **Who it affects:** Learners, apprentices, teachers, employers and small businesses in vocational training.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is asked to reflect these ideas in its upcoming European vocational training strategy.
